name: Now There's Two!?
source:
The official sequel to My Sweet Stalker!
Experience the chilling thrill of obsessive love... once again.
To celebrate the release of Part 2, all premium choices in Part 1 are now 50% off!

■Synopsis■
After surviving a horrifying stalker incident, you've finally settled back into a peaceful life. But everything unravels when you meet a woman who looks exactly like Kimiko—the girl who nearly destroyed your world. She’s Kimiko’s twin sister, Kimika, and her obsession might be even more dangerous. Just as things spiral out of control, Kimiko suddenly reappears… with no memory of you or what happened.
Trapped between two sisters obsessed with you—what path will you choose?

■Characters■

Mei
Your cheerful childhood friend who’s always been by your side. Her bright optimism and unwavering support helped you recover from the past. As danger creeps back in, your bond with her grows deeper—and may blossom into something more.

Shiki
A calm, brilliant woman with secret ties to the underworld. Though she appears unassuming, she’s secretly investigating Kimiko’s past. With quiet courage and hidden compassion, she’s ready to risk it all to protect you.

Tatsumi
A former police officer turned private investigator. Tough, sharp, and dependable, Tatsumi played a key role in the stalker case and still watches over you like a protective older sister. Her tough love hides a caring heart.

Kimiko
Once your dangerously obsessed stalker, Kimiko now suffers from amnesia and clings to you with seemingly innocent affection. But is she truly changed—or is a nightmare waiting to resurface behind her smile?

■About This App■
This is an interactive romantic thriller where your choices shape the story.
Premium choices unlock exclusive romance scenes and essential plot revelations.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.stalker2&hl=en]Google Play[/url]]
